timingScope: Diagnostic frame includes mutation, preparation, target bind/clear, composition and blocking one-pixel readback. CPU counters bracket whole windows; OS/thread/heap sampling and all output are outside windows.
schedulingScope: Allowed priority/affinity and coarse cumulative CPU times/cycles; main is read before process and live threads are sampled sequentially. Process-minus-main includes read-order uncertainty and transient threads; no actual processor-placement, context-switch, call-stack or dedicated-host proof.
heapScope: 128 process-owned heaps; busy/free/committed bytes exclude non-heap virtual allocations. Traversal/lock time is not independently bounded; the wrapper limits its owned child to 120 seconds. Stage counters include prior sampling overhead.
storageScope: Entry includes fixed stage/window telemetry storage. Fixed bytes exclude additional string allocations and native enumeration scratch; heap JSON size/capacity is informational and may overlap fixed string object storage. Thread enumeration scans at most 65536 system records and retains at most 256 owned threads per stage.
captureValidationScope: PNG structure, CRC, bounded chunks, IHDR 1280x720, IDAT and final IEND only; decoding and populated-scene visual proof belong to the native capture gate.
benchmarkInputsScope: benchmarkInputs/benchmarkSha256 retain the canonical ComplexUi closure; profilingInputs binds this diagnostic fixture, shared helpers, dispatcher and runner.
measurement: Diagnostic only. Fixed extra warmup and sampling are not canonical acceptance; no regression, trusted-policy, actual scheduling, heap-owner or dedicated-host verdict.
